planned_policies.activation: existing automatic manual ability plus finite one-use resource cost; consume on accepted cast start
planned_policies.targeting: source postfilter12 maps STUN0 exclusion; taunt/newest-ID deterministic ordering remains explicit replacement
planned_policies.range: actual skill BB3.0 point radius; raw CircleCollider2D2.0 is fallback source geometry, not silently substituted
planned_policies.windup: Skill_Begin26 authoredframes then Skill_Loop OnAttack0 launch; not loop14 damage period
planned_policies.flight: declared planar homing speed10 to captured target; native HarpoonMovement body/physics pending
planned_policies.link_duration: actual hit_duration20 overrides raw generic linkDuration5/life5 for held phase; raw5 retained for flight limit
planned_policies.damage: integrate source atk*.35 arts rate using actual quantum packets; Native MeleeModifierSplitter body pending
planned_policies.refresh: target infinite STUN0 refreshed each1second, all owned leases removed on channel end/interruption/death
planned_policies.caster_hold: actual self-active STUN0 represented as cast-owned hold; own hold does not interrupt its same cast
planned_policies.recovery: retain source _minPostDelayWhenProjectileInvalid0.6669999957 alongside authored Skill_End20frames; ceiling quantizer referencepolicy
planned_policies.sp: SourceAttackType BUFF4 is explicit; continuous damage ignore-SP policy must be declared, not hidden unused params
